RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel selecting a male candidate with fewer technical credentials can reflect affinity bias, but leadership experience and management training are legitimate criteria for department head roles. Panel composition alone does not prove discrimination.

Do not lead with an accusation of bias. First, send a professional follow-up requesting your written feedback, citing standard timelines. Review hospital recruitment policies to check whether diverse interview panels are mandated. If they refuse to provide objective, competency-based justifications or if formal recruitment guidelines were breached, you can then consider raising procedural fairness concerns or consulting an employment specialist regarding potential sex discrimination.
